  - n152 (number-input @ x=-1607, y=1128): sets the end index for slicing the bundle (e.g., limit to N items).

- **prompt building** (lower left, separate chain):

  - n137 (text-input @ x=-2690, y=1823): second fragment.

  - n139 (text-join @ x=-937, y=1673): joins n138's output + n136. connects: n138.out → n139.a; n136.out → n139.b.
  - n140 (preview @ x=-1351, y=1769, collapsed): previews the joined text (likely a constructed prompt or path). connects: n139.out → n140.in. its output reroutes elsewhere (see below).

### loop decomposition (middle left)
- n131 (loop-decompose @ x=-518, y=651): breaks the image-bundle from n130 into per-item elements (item: individual image; index: its position).
  - connects: n130.out → n131.bundle.
- index processing for naming:

  - n146 (text-input @ x=-413, y=-11): provides a base string (e.g., prefix for output names).

  - n151 (reroute @ x=536, y=183): passes the joined name forward. connects: n149.out → n151.in.

### core editing command (center)
